panels.description: Gesamtanzahl eingetragener Schiffe. Bei Woche, Monat, Quartal oder Jahr: Stand am Ende des Zeitraums.

targets.rawSql:
WITH resolution AS (
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN ${resolution:sqlstring} IN ('day', 'week', 'month', 'quarter', 'year') THEN ${resolution:sqlstring}
    WHEN range_days <= 92 THEN 'day'
    WHEN range_days <= 731 THEN 'week'
    ELSE 'month'
  END AS unit
  FROM (
    SELECT ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')::date - ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')::date AS range_days
  ) AS time_range
),
period_values AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (period) day, value
  FROM (
    SELECT date_trunc((SELECT unit FROM resolution), day::timestamp) AS period, day, sum(ship_count) AS value
    FROM statistics.daily_ship_counts
    WHERE day <= ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')::date
    GROUP BY day
  ) AS daily_values
  ORDER BY period, day DESC
)
SELECT time, value AS "Gesamt", change AS "Veränderung zur Vorperiode"
FROM (
  SELECT day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin' AS time, value, value - lag(value) OVER (ORDER BY day) AS change
  FROM period_values
) AS period_changes
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Anzahl eingetragener Schiffe pro Variante. Bei Woche, Monat, Quartal oder Jahr: Stand am Ende des Zeitraums.

targets.rawSql:
WITH resolution AS (
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN ${resolution:sqlstring} IN ('day', 'week', 'month', 'quarter', 'year') THEN ${resolution:sqlstring}
    WHEN range_days <= 92 THEN 'day'
    WHEN range_days <= 731 THEN 'week'
    ELSE 'month'
  END AS unit
  FROM (
    SELECT ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')::date - ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')::date AS range_days
  ) AS time_range
),
counts AS (
  SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (id, period) day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin' AS time, id, name, value
    FROM (
      SELECT date_trunc((SELECT unit FROM resolution), day::timestamp) AS period, day, variant_id AS id, variant_name AS name, ship_count AS value
      FROM statistics.daily_ship_counts
      WHERE variant_id IN (${variants:sqlstring})
        AND day <= ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')::date
    ) AS daily_counts
    ORDER BY id, period, day DESC
  ) AS period_counts
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
),
last_values AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (id) id, name, value
  FROM counts
  ORDER BY id, time DESC
),
selection AS (
  SELECT count(*) = (SELECT count(*) FROM statistics.ship_variants) AS is_all
  FROM statistics.ship_variants
  WHERE variant_id IN (${variants:sqlstring})
),
top_series AS (
  SELECT id, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY value DESC, name COLLATE "und-x-icu", id COLLATE "und-x-icu") AS position
  FROM last_values
  WHERE id IN (
    SELECT id FROM counts GROUP BY id
    HAVING max(value) > 0 OR NOT (SELECT is_all FROM selection)
  )
  ORDER BY position
  LIMIT ${top:sqlstring}::integer
)
SELECT time, id, name, value
FROM counts
JOIN top_series USING (id)
ORDER BY position, time
